items.definition:
Resembling or relating to a penis
The ancient sculpture had distinct phallic symbols.

Having or showing knowledge of events before they take place
Her prescient warning about the market crash proved accurate.

(of a garment) close-fitting and flowing; (of a person or animal) moving with a smooth, quiet, and graceful walk
She wore a slinky black dress to the party.

loud and harsh; grating
Her strident voice cut through the noise of the crowd.

not required or expected to justify actions or decisions; inexplicable
The politician was criticized for being unaccountable to the public.

impossible to know or understand
The future is unknowable.

of or like vinegar; sour
The strong acetic smell indicated the presence of vinegar.

lacking a moral sense; unconcerned with right or wrong
Some philosophers argue that nature itself is amoral, simply existing without judgment.

Secretly keeping one's identity or beliefs hidden, especially regarding sexual orientation.
He remained closeted about his true feelings for many years.

Relating to marriage or the relationship between a married couple.
They were granted conjugal visits while he was in prison.

relating to or denoting a chemical bond formed by the sharing of electrons
Water molecules are held together by strong covalent bonds.

shaped like a cross
He tore his anterior cruciate ligament during the game.

characterized by or based on the inference of particular instances by reference to a general law or principle
Sherlock Holmes was famous for his deductive reasoning.

relating to the epidermis (outer layer of skin)
The cream is designed to treat epidermal issues.

relating to ancient Etruria or its people, language, or culture
We studied ancient Etruscan art in history class.

exceptionally good; outstanding
He is a chef extraordinaire.

resembling a farce; absurd
The whole situation became utterly farcical.

denoting a period of time in the past that was idyllically happy and peaceful
He often reminisced about the halcyon days of his youth.

relating to or causing orgasm; intensely pleasurable
The dessert was described as an orgasmic experience by the food critic.

making or indicating timely preparation for the future; prudent
A provident person saves money for retirement.

reaching or having reached puberty
The study focused on changes in pubescent adolescents.

Extremely delicious or appealing.
The cake was absolutely scrumptious.

Stylishly luxurious and expensive.
They stayed in a swanky hotel downtown.

full of twists and turns; excessively long and complex
The tortuous path led us deep into the mountains.

celebrating a triumph or victory
The team made a triumphal return after winning the championship.

not blocked or hindered
The room offered an unobstructed view of the ocean.

not attracting attention
The camera was designed to be unobtrusive, blending into the background.

not knowing or aware
He was an unwitting accomplice in the crime.

under a curse; doomed
The old house was said to be accursed.

filled with horror or shock
She was aghast at the terrible news.

having or showing a desire to achieve success or a higher status
The company's new product is aimed at aspirational consumers.

relating to the treatment of obesity
The hospital specializes in bariatric surgery.

showing contempt; scornful
He gave a contemptuous laugh at her suggestion.

wicked and cruel
The villain committed a dastardly act.

having breaks or gaps; not continuous
The data showed a discontinuous pattern.

based on a mistaken belief
His argument was based on fallacious reasoning.

very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail
He was fastidious about his appearance.

of or due from a son or daughter
She showed great filial devotion to her elderly parents.

soft and hanging loosely or limply
The plant leaves became flaccid from lack of water.

polite, refined, or respectable, often in an affected or ostentatious way
She came from a genteel family with old money.

fluent but insincere and shallow
He gave a glib answer that didn't address the real issue.

unable to be captured or broken into
The fortress was considered impregnable due to its thick walls and strategic location.

drunk; intoxicated
He was clearly inebriated after several drinks.

lacking flavor or interest
The soup was insipid and bland.

short-sighted; lacking foresight
His myopic view of the economy prevented him from seeing the long-term consequences.

lacking distinctive or interesting features
He lived in a nondescript house on a quiet street.

easily bent or influenced
The artist used a pliable material that could be easily molded.

relating to reference
The artist's work is highly referential, drawing on many historical styles.

very hot and dry; full of intense emotion
They endured the torrid heat of the desert.

characterized by or causing ulcers
Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease.

absolute; unqualified
The project was an unmitigated disaster.

relating to or derived from urine
High levels of uric acid can lead to gout.

high-sounding but with little meaning; pompous
His bombastic speech failed to impress the audience.

relating to or having the property of capacitance
Modern smartphones use capacitive touchscreens.

relating to a person's body, especially as opposed to their spirit
He believed in a spiritual existence beyond the corporeal world.

relating to or denoting the science of communications and automatic control systems in both machines and living things
The robot was designed with advanced cybernetic systems.

clearly apparent or capable of being logically proved
His talent was clearly demonstrable from a young age.

Relating to or characterized by conflict within an organization or group.
The party was plagued by factional disputes.

extremely small
The chances of winning the lottery were infinitesimal.

feeling or expressing great joy and triumph
The team was jubilant after winning the championship.

relating to karma
He believed his good fortune was a result of karmic balance.

relating to the breasts or mammary glands
The veterinarian examined the dog's mammary glands.

Characteristic of the dystopian future depicted in George Orwell's novel Nineteen Eighty-Four.
The new surveillance laws have an Orwellian feel to them.

Relating to or denoting an utterance that constitutes the performance of an act.
Saying 'I do' in a wedding ceremony is a performative utterance.
